svg.title: What fair share means
svg.desc: Two grids of one hundred: the made-up seat share for AA on DFW to Chicago in Q3 2026, 37.6%, and the 53.5% of Summit Travel Partners' sales on that route that went to AA, a premium of 15.9 points.
svg.text: Summit's sales on the same route
went to AA: the AA share
With the made-up seat shares, an agency that sold every airline in proportion to its seats would give AA 37.6% here. Summit gives 53.5%.
